title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Abrogating Certain Judicial Interpretations and Documents of a Judicial Interpretation Nature Issued During the Period from January 1, 1980 to June 30, 1997

articles.content_en:
January 4, 2013
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate
Decision on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations and Documents of a Judicial Interpretation Nature Issued from January 1, 1980 to June 30, 1997
Fa Shi [2013] No. 1
In order to adapt to changes in the situation and ensure the uniform and correct application of national laws, and pursuant to relevant legal provisions and the practical needs of adjudication and procuratorial work, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, together with relevant departments, have conducted a centralized review of the judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature jointly issued from January 1, 1980 to June 30, 1997. It is hereby decided to abolish 44 judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature issued from January 1, 1980 to June 30, 1997. The abolished judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature shall no longer be applicable from the date of coming into force of this Decision, but the judgments and rulings made in relevant cases based on the following judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature in the past shall remain valid.
